title: Randomized decision tree with possible error
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\alpha$ be types, and let $n$ be a natural number. A randomized decision tree consists of a finite, nonempty seed space, a probability mass function on that space, and, for each seed, a finite decision tree that queries coordinates of an $n$-coordinate input over $\Omega$ and returns a label in $\alpha$.
hypotheses_covered: A probability mass function is specified on the seed space
Each seed selects a finite decision tree
